workflow_runs.display_title: TUI: make Enter submit reliably on Windows when input wraps (fallback when keyboard enhancements unsupported)

head_commit.message:
tui: submit on Enter when keyboard enhancements unsupported (Windows consoles)

Some Windows terminals don’t reliably report Shift on Enter once the input wraps, breaking Enter-to-send after the first line.

- Add is_plain_enter() that treats Enter as submit as long as Ctrl/Alt aren’t held when keyboard enhancement flags are unsupported.
- Preserve existing behavior on capable terminals: Enter submits; Shift+Enter inserts newline.

Fixes #6307
